verdict.rationale: Jitsu's connector syncs run as scheduled Kubernetes CronJobs, and Data Warehouse Batch jobs plus failure/recovery notifications imply built-in recurring job execution (jitsu-docs-41, jitsu-docs-65). However, there's no evidence of user-facing controls to define custom schedules/cadences, nor documentation of an AI-native workflow for creating or managing recurring jobs beyond the fixed connector-sync cadence. missing for 10: explicit user/agent-configurable scheduling (cron expressions, intervals), evidence that MCP/agent can create or modify job schedules, broader workflow orchestration beyond data sync.
